name: Quell
description: Quell was a terrestrial planet located in the Quell system of the Outer Rim Territories. In 21 BBY, the planet served as a site of a Clone Wars engagement, where the Galactic Republic task force of Jedi General Aayla Secura was attacked by a Confederacy of Independent Systems squadron of frigates commanded by the T-series tactical droid TF-1726. During the battle, the Republic forces were inflicted with heavy casualties as the Confederacy claimed victory.
